name: 户外露营随身净水泡腾片款

styleLock.direction: clean outdoor water-treatment commerce with cool infographic panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio field #FFFFFF for packshots and macro, ice-blue infographic panel #DCE7F2 for data screens, deep lake-blue #2F5D8C for benefit and close panels; one panel per shot, no gradient murals
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool key light from the upper left around 6500K, soft wrap fill, soft contact shadows grounding every object, controlled highlight on glossy surfaces, no harsh specular blowout
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless studio field #FFFFFF, fine pale sand field #E3D9C6, matte rock ledge #B8BFC6, matte board panel #DCE7F2
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline plus short label rows, all rendered copy limited to placeholder slots
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in a center rail, accent #3FA0DC, flat style, no 3D and no shading
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the upright container, container always grounded by a contact shadow, single piece units fanned at the base, product never occluded by props or hands
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool outdoor water-treatment commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio field #FFFFFF, ice-blue infographic panel #DCE7F2, deep lake-blue #2F5D8C and one bright water accent #3FA0DC; cool key light from the upper left around 6500K with soft wrap fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one headline and short label rows only; thin single-weight line icons in a center rail; matte stone, pale sand and seamless studio surfaces; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the upright container with pieces fanned at its base; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.lighting: cool even high-key key light from the upper left around 6500K, soft wrap fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow under container and pieces
shots.background: seamless studio field #FFFFFF with a faint glossy reflection beneath the base
shots.props: none beyond loose pieces fanned in front of the base
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, clean margin around the silhouette
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Purpose: win the search click with a compliant clean packshot. The upright container stands centered, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn, full product inside the frame. Cool even high-key key light from the upper left around 6500K with a soft wrap fill, soft contact shadow grounding the container and the loose pieces fanned at its base. Seamless studio field #FFFFFF with a faint glossy reflection under the base. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. Sharp edges and true material rendering, square marketplace-safe framing. Negative: no text, no badges, no star ratings, no platform badges, no watermark, no hands, no scenery, no props, no colored backdrop, no gradient background, no floating product without contact shadow, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底摆拍，直立瓶与前方散落的圆片，标签版式为品牌字标加参数文字；002 三格拼贴，一格为产品半埋在细沙上，一格为四人搭肩背影远眺山脊，一格为巨大半透明储水桶上方悬一滴液体加大字主张；003 为左右两栏对照表，中轴六枚细线图标（时钟/水滴/双片/球形/硬币/拇指），两栏各六行主张文字；004 为中心裁切产品加四到五格斜切场景（营地帐篷与折叠椅、山脊背影徒步者、舟钓二人、风暴残骸、打开的装备包）；005 为雪山山脊徒步者背影加吊卡包装、条状小包、瓶与散片组合，右上角巨大字标、右下大字主张。品类判定依据：源图场景全部为露营帐篷、登山山脊、舟钓与荒漠取水，产品为随身净水耗材，非着妆非护肤非家电，故按图取 L1 运动户外、L2 露营（帐篷露营场景最重，登山与舟钓并入场景镜），未沿用源平台常错挂的保健或水处理类目。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、店铺字样、瓶身标签上的重量与片数与毫克等全部数值、杀灭与除味等功效与主张原句、机构与人群背书句、年度处理量等社会证明数字、对照表中两栏全部具体主张与竞品暗示、平台徽章与星条；参数与主张一律改为空参数行、空白表格单元、空印章框、留空指示条与 {callout_n}、{selling_point_n} 占位。
